text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Netanyahu: UN resolution 242 applies to Golan.
- Army Northern Commander Levine warns Hizbollah.
- French Foreign Minister De Charette: peace process key to stopping violence in Lebanon.
- Russia responded to Damascus request for aid in improving Syrian army.
- Half billion dollar surplus recorded in January balance of payments.
- Soldier killed and officer seriously wounded in battle between army and Hizbollah.
- Shas angry over police intent to order Rabbi Ovadiah Yosef to testify in attorney-general affair.
- Turkish army chiefs warn Prime Minister Erbakan: 'disciplinary steps will be taken against Islamic fanatics'.
- Banks preparing for strike on Tuesday.
- Survivor of helicopter disaster killed by missile in Lebanon.
- Netanyahu expects demonstration of support in Likud central committee.
- Army checks if terrorists began using new type of anti-tank missiles.
- Arafat threatens to declare Palestinian state.
